description: Free preview. Find companies whose name, domain, industry or description contains the query (case-insensitive substring, not semantic). Use this to discover companies or resolve a partial name to a domain, then call get_company_enrichment (paid) for the full record. Returns { count, companies: [{ name, domain, industry }] }, best name matches first; an empty list means no matches. Default 10 results, max 25. Free.

query.description: Text to look for, e.g. "robotics" or "fintech"

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
